# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.4.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.4   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Usually the secuity issue is an upstream problem so it is upto other develop teams. However, if you find a problem _directly_ in my code, please send an email to [us](mailto:tao-nianze@hiroshima-u.ac.jp?subject=Securty%20Issue%20of%20bayesianflow-for-chem&body=I%20have%20an%20issue%20to%20report.).
